title: World Cup watch
brief: A high-energy broadcast-graphics slide deck on who is lighting up FIFA World Cup 2026 right now, snapshotted 3 July 2026 mid-knockouts (Round of 32 into the Round of 16). Twelve slides cover the Golden Boot race (Mbappe and Messi level on six, Mbappe leading on the assists tiebreak; Kane and Haaland on five), the standout team (France, No.1 in ESPN's power ranking), the surprise package (Cape Verde, the smallest nation ever to reach the knockouts) alongside Africa's moment, the player of the tournament so far (Mbappe vs Messi with their record hauls), the best goal (Undav's give-and-go with Wirtz plus Messi and Mbappe contenders), a stat board, a who's-left bracket to the 19 July MetLife final, Maradona's picks for the final and winner, and a fully cited sources slide. Every figure is web-verified across FIFA, ESPN, FOX Sports, Sky Sports, Yahoo, Wikipedia, Al Jazeera and NPR; live ties still to play are marked TBD and no scoreline or stat is invented.
da: Broadcast graphics: bright white/light stage, vivid saturated color blocks, giant Anton condensed numerals over clean Figtree sans, bold team-color accents and lower-third motifs.
